vectors.name: roads
vectors.title: Roads
vectors.abstract: Road centerlines for the Jacksonville area of interest. Loaded from vector/sql/roads.sql when that PGDump is present, otherwise from vector/gpkg/roads.gpkg.

vectors.name: tracts
vectors.title: Census tracts
vectors.abstract: Census tracts covering the Jacksonville area of interest.

vectors.name: aoi
vectors.title: Area of interest
vectors.abstract: Demonstration window from aoi_26917.geojson. Downtown Jacksonville through NAS Jacksonville.

vectors.name: parcels
vectors.title: Duval County parcels
vectors.abstract: Parcel polygons. The parcel key column is re. Owner names are not included.

vectors.name: mirta
vectors.title: MIRTA installations
vectors.abstract: Florida installation polygons. The site name column is sitename. Sample polygons built when the real extract is missing are labeled as samples.

vectors.name: editor_notes
vectors.title: Editor notes
vectors.abstract: Points an editor can create and delete with WFS transactions. This table is created empty by the database script. It is not part of the county extract.

rasters.name: naip
rasters.title: NAIP imagery 2025
rasters.abstract: 2025 NAIP imagery for the Jacksonville area of interest, stored as a JPEG-compressed Cloud Optimized GeoTIFF at imagery/naip_2025_jax_aoi_cog.tif.

rasters.name: dem
rasters.title: 3DEP elevation
rasters.abstract: USGS 3DEP bare-earth elevation in meters at elevation/dem_3dep_aoi_cog.tif. Nodata is -999999. Elevations in this window run from about -3 m to 19 m.

rasters.name: hillshade
rasters.title: Hillshade
rasters.abstract: 8-bit hillshade derived from the 3DEP grid, at elevation/hillshade_aoi_cog.tif.
